reference.notes:
`generateId` now uses the prefix you pass it, and all tests pass: the whole package suite ran 222 tests with 0 failures, including every `generate-id.*` and `hidden-generate-id/` test.

Most of the spec was already done when I started. The schema split was in place, with `src/schema/auth.ts`, `organizations.ts` and `todos.ts` holding the tables and `src/schema.ts` re-exporting them. `ID_PREFIXES`, `IdPrefix` and the new `generateId` signature were also already written. I didn't change any of that.

The only change is the body of `generateId` in `src/mapping.ts`, which still built every id as `todo_…`. It now:
- throws `RangeError("Unknown id prefix: " + JSON.stringify(prefix))` if the prefix isn't exactly one of the six `ID_PREFIXES` values (case-sensitive, no trimming), and does this before generating anything;
- otherwise returns `` `${prefix}_${crypto.randomUUID()}` ``;
- falls back to `"todo"` when the argument is missing or `undefined`, while `null` is rejected.
